scripts.format: turbo run format py:format js:format md:fix
scripts.py:fix: uv run -m ruff check --fix . && uv run -m ruff format . && uv run -m ty check --fix .
scripts.py:typecheck: uv run -m pyright && uv run -m ty check --output-format github
scripts.i18n: uv run pybabel extract -F src/plugins/nonebot_plugin_lingchu_bot/i18n/babel.cfg -o src/plugins/nonebot_plugin_lingchu_bot/i18n/messages.pot src/plugins/nonebot_plugin_lingchu_bot && uv run pybabel update -i src/plugins/nonebot_plugin_lingchu_bot/i18n/messages.pot -d src/plugins/nonebot_plugin_lingchu_bot/i18n/locales -D messages && uv run pybabel compile -d src/plugins/nonebot_plugin_lingchu_bot/i18n/locales -D messages
scripts.i18n:cli: cd apps/lingc-cli && uv run pybabel extract -F babel.cfg -o messages.pot src/lingc_cli && uv run pybabel update -i messages.pot -d src/lingc_cli/locales -D messages && uv run pybabel compile -d src/lingc_cli/locales -D messages
